Welcome to the NIST Research Library and Museum (Library). The Library is responsible for creating, maintaining, and disseminating a NIST knowledge base which supports the research and administrative needs required to fulfill the scientific, engineering, and technical mission of NIST. NIST Staff can find resources on our internal site (restricted access) Contact the Library: library [at] nist.gov (library[at]nist[dot]gov) ● (301) 975-3052 Is the NIST Research Library open to the public?
